			say("player", "No.")

			say("carol", "I just cleaned down there, you'll get the floor dirty.")
			say("player", "In which case I shall remain here.")

			say("carol", "Yeah, that's Terry.")
			say("carol", "He works in HR.")

			say("carol", "Oh yeah, go on then.")

:setup
	if plant_state == 2:

	else:

	scumm_fade_in()

:ready
	var first_init = 0
	var quick_init = 0
	first_init = !inited_game
	quick_init = first_init and did_office_intro
	if !(inited_game):
		inited_game = 1
	else:
		ensign_zob_room = "OfficeRoom"
		set_active("player", true)
		teleport_pos("player", 1184, 440)
		walk_to_pos("player", 1000, 440)
		if light_switch_state == 1:
			scumm_room_intensity(143, 123, 119)
		stop
	if !(did_office_intro):
		accept_input("SKIP")
		set_gui_visible(false)
		did_office_intro = 1
		wait(2.5)
		ensign_zob_room = "OfficeRoom"
		set_active("player", true)
		teleport_pos("player", 680, 440)
		commander_zif_room = "OfficeRoom"
		set_active("commander_zif", true)
		teleport_pos("commander_zif", 800, 480)
		scumm_sound("res://sounds/beamed_snd.wav")
		scumm_anim("commander_zif", "beam")
		scumm_anim("player", "beam")
		wait(2.5)
		say("commander_zif", "Hmmm...")
		# Actors::setZifOnThePhone()
		set_animations("commander_zif", "res://characters/commander_zif/commander_zif_stand_with_phone_talk_to_phone_start.tres")
		scumm_sound("res://sounds/phone_snd.wav")

		wait(2.0)
		anim("carol", "idle_down")
		say("carol", "Are you done in here?")
		turn_to("commander_zif", "carol")
		turn_to("player", "carol")

scripts.res://rooms/secret_room/objects/computer:
:use
	if terminal_activated and !cube_disappeared:
		scumm_roam("commander_zif", "pause")
		accept_input("SKIP")
		set_gui_visible(false)
		scumm_anim("player", "raise_arm")
		wait(0.42)
		scumm_anim("player", "lower_arm")
		wait(0.42)
		scumm_anim("cube_actor", "dissolve")
		wait(0.83)
		say("player", "Looks like I broke the encryption.")
		commander_zif_room = "SecretRoom"
		set_active("commander_zif", true)
		teleport_pos("commander_zif", 160, 400)
		walk_to_pos_block("commander_zif", 380, 400)
		turn_to("commander_zif", "player")
		say("commander_zif", "Well done, ensign.")
		say("commander_zif", "Now retrieve the relic!")
		say("player", "Small problem, sir.")
		say("commander_zif", "What's that?")
		say("player", "It is still held in place.")
		say("commander_zif", "Then find a way to bring it down.")
		say("player", "Aye, sir!")
		# override block (not skipped: VAR_OVERRIDE = 0)
		cube_actor_room = "InventoryItems"
		set_active("cube_actor", false)
		cube_disappeared = 1
		scumm_roam("commander_zif", "start", 320, 880, 420, 520)
		accept_input("ALL")
		set_gui_visible(true)
	elif cube_disappeared:
		say("player", "The terminal has shut down.")
	else:
		say("player", "The terminal is offline.")

:look
	say("player", "Looks pretty ordinary.")
